name: people
title: People (data/people.csv)
description: Hand-maintained. One row per distinct person named as a commander (or acting, temporary, deputy or embarked commander) in the claims. No tenure dates on this table; those live in data/unit_commanders.csv. Biographical life dates are out of scope. Person ids PE0001 onward are never reused or renumbered.

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: Stable id, PE0001 onward. Never reused or renumbered.

fields.name: canonical_name
fields.description: Display name without rank: Hans von Obstfelder, Omar N. Bradley, Günther Blumentritt. Prefer the fullest sourced form, with the person's own diacritics when a source uses them.

fields.name: sort_name
fields.description: Sort key: Obstfelder, Hans von; Bradley, Omar N.

fields.name: given_names
fields.description: Given names or initials (Hans, Omar N., Günther). Blank when only a surname is sourced.

fields.name: name_particles
fields.description: Particles and nobiliary predicates as written (von, de, van, Freiherr, Graf, und zu).

fields.name: generation
fields.description: Generational suffix when part of the sourced name (Jr.).

fields.name: alt_names
fields.description: Semicolon-separated other spellings actually seen in claims or cited sources (Guenther Blumentritt, Luettwitz). Ranks do not belong here.

fields.name: nationality
fields.description: The name value of a row of data/nationalities.csv, filled only when the officer's nation is clear. Blank rather than guessed.

fields.name: name_completeness
fields.description: How complete the sourced name is (vocabulary name_completeness).

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Disambiguation and sourcing remarks. Not a place to store unsourced biography.
